user.title: Connect to SaverSwap
user.description: Enter the address of the computer running SaverSwap, like 192.168.1.10 (port 8099 is assumed). Set up the server first: https://github.com/HansDandle/SaverSwap

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach SaverSwap at that address. Is it running, and is the address right?

init.title: What to show on the TV
init.description: These appear under the clock and weather while SaverSwap is on screen. Locks, doors, garage doors and alarms show in amber when they need attention.

data.attention_only: Only show locks, doors, covers and alarms when they need attention (unlocked, open, wet...)

data_description.labels: One per line, like:  lock.front_door = Front door

show_camera.name: Show camera on TV
show_camera.description: Puts a camera's picture in the corner of SaverSwap, refreshed every few seconds, for a while.

title.name: Title
title.description: Label above the picture (default: camera name).

seconds.name: For how long
seconds.description: Seconds to keep it on screen.

turn_on_tv.name: Bring up SaverSwap
turn_on_tv.description: Also open SaverSwap on TVs that are idle (home screen or screensaver). Never interrupts something you're watching.

toggle.name: Toggle
toggle.description: If this camera is already on the TV, hide it instead. Lets one dashboard button show and hide it.

show_message.name: Show message on TV
show_message.description: Shows a line of text at the bottom of SaverSwap.

seconds.name: For how long
seconds.description: Seconds to keep it on screen.

turn_on_tv.name: Bring up SaverSwap
turn_on_tv.description: Also open SaverSwap on TVs that are idle.

clear.name: Clear
clear.description: Removes the camera picture and/or message from the TV.
